description: Official documentation pages known for each service, initialized by hand for common services (virtual machines and managed databases of AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud). A service is identified by its name (offer type, and engine for a database) and its provider. URLs validated by an expert at run time are kept in doc_urls_validated.json.
selection_rule: For each service, 1 to 3 official pages of the documentation of that service itself: (1) the page that describes the network in which the service is deployed (VPC, subnet, virtual network, network interface); (2) the page that describes the network access control of the service (security group, network security group, firewall rules), when the documentation of the service has one.

Excluded: general overviews of another product (e.g., 'What is Amazon VPC' for Amazon EC2), tutorials, quickstarts, best practices, pricing pages, API references, and pages of optional features (e.g., key pairs).
The rule is applied to every service of the list at once; the list is frozen before the evaluation (copies made with snapshot_docs.py) and is not changed afterwards.
